title: India Food Watchdog to Tighten Grip on $80 Billion Online Market
description: India’s top food regulator is preparing tighter rules for quick delivery online platforms, including Blinkit, Swiggy Ltd.’s Instamart and Amazon Now, as it intensifies a nationwide crackdown on unsafe practices across the world’s largest consumer market.

title: Tencent Kicks Off $5 Billion Bond Sale to Finance AI Spending
description: Tencent Holdings Ltd. began marketing dollar and offshore yuan bonds in an offering that could raise around $5 billion to support its escalating investments in artificial intelligence.

title: Muse Wonder Puts Meta's Aggressive AI Push in Focus
description: Meta Platforms released a new artificial intelligence model called Muse Wonder, which the company claims is a big leap over its predecessors. Riley Griffin has more on "The Asia Trade." (Source: Bloomberg)
